envelope.description: Switch the tracker-auto call sites to the adapter

body.title: Switch the tracker-auto call sites to the adapter
body.summary: Change autoPushEpicOnHld, autoPushStoryOnLld and autoPushTasksOnPlan to call the adapter built from the already-resolved lenient config, applying the one unwrapping rule: operations that threw are unwrapped by throwing, the adoption lookup maps a failed lookup to undefined, ensureLabel and ensureMilestone keep their legacy results. No change to labels, order, best-effort wrapping or persisted TrackerMeta.
acceptanceChecks: The three push functions produce the same gh argv sequence, best-effort behaviour and TrackerMeta as before, including fail-open when gh is unavailable
A failing adoption lookup does not throw and still goes on to create the Epic issue
A failing create is reported as a failed result by the existing try/catch, not thrown

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/tracker-auto.test.ts: the three push functions keep their gh sequence, best-effort behaviour and TrackerMeta through the adapter
src/workflow/__tests__/tracker-auto.test.ts: a failing adoption lookup still leads to a create and does not throw
src/workflow/__tests__/tracker-auto.test.ts: a failing create is reported as a failed result, not thrown
